greeting: Egameni likaYise, nelikaNyana, nelikaMoya oyiNgcwele. Makube noxolo lweNkosi yethu uYesu Krestu nani nonke.
penitential: Nkosi, ube nenceba kuthi. Krestu, ube nenceba kuthi. Nkosi, ube nenceba kuthi.
psalm_response: Ndiza kuhlala umoyisi ecaleni kwam etroneni yam.
homily:
Cinga ngomzuzu apho ubona umntwana omncinci, eneminyaka emibini okanye emithathu, ehleli phantsi, edlala ngezinto ezincinci ekhitshini, amehlo akhe eqaqambile, egcwele umdla ngayo yonke into emngqongileyo. UBenjamin Vo wayenalo olo hlobo lwembono—imbono eyayibona ubuhle kwizinto ezincinci, eyayifuna ukwazi ukuba izinto zisebenza njani, nokuba yikhompyutha okanye yindlela iinqwelo-moya ezibhabha ngayo emoyeni. Xa uBen wayesemncinci, wayenendlela yokujonga ihlabathi eyayifana nendlela uZakeyu awayejonge ngayo uYesu kwiVangeli yanamhlanje. UZakeyu wayemfutshane, wayengakwazi ukubona uYesu ngenxa yesihlwele, kodwa akazange anikezele. Wenyuka umthi womkhiwane. Wenyuka ukuze abone… ukuze abone ngaphaya kwesihlwele, ngaphaya kokungazi kwabantu, ngaphaya kwemida yakhe.

KwiVangeli, uYesu uthi kuZakeyu, 'Zakeyu, hla ngokukhawuleza, kuba namhlanje ndimelwe kukuhlala endlwini yakho.' Masiyimele kancinci le ndinyana… UYesu akazange alinde ukuba uZakeyu abe ngumntu ogqibeleleyo. Akazange alinde ukuba uZakeyu alungise konke okwakungahambi kakuhle ebomini bakhe. UYesu wamcela ukuba 'ehle,' ukuba aphume kwindawo yakhe ephakamileyo, ukuze amamkele kuye. Le yindlela uThixo asebenza ngayo. Uza kuthi, kwiindawo apho siziva siphantsi, kwiindawo apho siziva singenamandla, kwaye uthi, 'Namhlanje, ndifuna ukuhlala nawe.'

Alan noThao, ndiyazi ukuba kule minyane mihlanu idlulileyo, ukususela ngowe-13 kuJuni 2026, kuye kwakho amaxesha apho iintlungu zifana nesihlwele esingavumeli ukuba nibone ukukhanya. Kukho amaxesha apho ukungabikho kukaBen kwenza ikhaya libe ngenye indlela. Mamele kakuhle: uThixo akakubeki icala. UBen akakubeki icala. Ezo zifo aziziswanga zizinto owazenzayo okanye ongazenzanga. Kweli hlabathi, kukho izinto ezenzeka ngaphandle kolawulo lomntu, ngaphandle kwempazamo yomzali. Awuphosanga nto. Uthando lwakho lwalucocekile, lwaluphelele, kwaye uBen wayesazi ukuba unothando olungaka kubazali bakhe nakuRyan. Khipha elo litye lokuzisola ezintliziyweni zenu namhlanje. UBen akajongi iziphoso; ujonge phezulu kuThixo, kwaye uqhubeka esithi kuwe: 'Ba, Mama, musani ukukhala kakhulu, ndikhuselekile.'

Khumbula indlela uBen awayenentliziyo evulekileyo ngayo. Khumbula loo mzuzu xa wayefuna ukunikela ngayo yonke imali yakhe yasebhange ukuze ancede umalume wakhe uWilliam. Wayengazange ayiphule loo ngulube, kodwa isipho sasingaphakathi entliziyweni yakhe. Le yimfihlelo yobomi: asikokuba unika malini, kodwa ukuba intliziyo yakho ikulungele na ukunika. UBen wayeyiqonda le nto. Wayengumfana owayethanda ukwabelana, owayethanda ukuhleka xa ethetha nge-'con chim airlines' yakhe, owayethanda ukuba noRyan ecaleni kwakhe. Uthando lwakhe lwalungapheliyo, kwaye lusaqhubeka lukhanya nangoku.

KwiNcwadi yeSityhilelo, uThixo uthi: 'Behold, I stand at the door and knock. If anyone hears my voice and opens the door, then I will enter his house and dine with him.' Masiyimele kancinci le ndinyana… UThixo akangqongqozi ngamandla. Ungqongqoza ngobunono. Ufuna nje ukuba uvule umnyango. Xa usiva ukuba uwedwa, xa usiva ukuba umthwalo unzima, khumbula ukuba uThixo ukhona, ulindile ukuba ungene, ukuba adle nawe, ukuba akuthuthuzele. UBen ukhona, uyaqhubeka, kwaye uya kuhlala ephila kuthando lukaThixo olungapheliyo. UBen akakho nje kwimbali yenu; ukwikhona apho uThixo enza khona yonke into ibe ntsha.

Ryan, mfowethu okhoyo apha, ndifuna uthathe oku nawe. UBen akakushiye. Ukhona ecaleni kwakho, eqhubeka ekusebenza njengesikhokelo sothando. UBen wayengumfana owayenenqgondo enkulu yezibalo nolwazi, kodwa ikratshi lakhe elikhulu kwakuwukuba ngumntwana omhle owayehlonipha abazali bakhe. UBen uya kuhlala ekukhuthaza, nangona ungamboni ngamehlo, kodwa uya kumva entliziyweni yakho. Uthando lwenu njengabazalwana luyinto engunaphakade.

Masithathe oku namhlanje: uBen wasishiya isipho sothando olungapheliyo. Kwisikhumbuzo sesidlo sasezulwini, lapho indlu kaThixo izele khona ngabantu abavela kude nakufi, masime nathi namhlanje siqinisekile ukuba ubomi bukaBen abuphelanga ethuneni. Usemthekweni wasezulwini, apho i-'con chim airlines' yakhe ibhabha ngokuphakamileyo phambi kobuso bukaThixo. Hamba ke namhlanje uphumle, uthembe ukuba uThixo uyakuthanda, kwaye uBen ulinda wena ngoncumo lwakhe oluqhelekileyo. Uthando lwakho, Ben, lusaqhubeka luhamba emhlabeni, lusaqhubeka lukhanya, kwaye lusaqhubeka lukhumbuza wonke umntu okwaziyo ukuba uThixo uyamthanda umntwana wakhe ngaphezu kwayo yonke into. Hlalani neli themba. Hlalani nolu thando. UBen ukhona, uyaqhubeka, kwaye uya kuhlala ephila kuthando lukaThixo olungapheliyo. Amen.
petitions: Sikhulekela uBen kunye nabo bonke abasishiyileyo, ukuze baphumle ekukhanyeni kukaKrestu, sithandaza.
Sikhulekela bonke abakhalayo ngenxa yokulahlekelwa, ukuze uThixo abathuthuzele abanike ithemba, sithandaza.
spiritual_communion: Yesu wam, ndiyakholelwa ukuba ukhona kule Ntsikelelo eNgcwele. Ndiyakuthanda ngaphezu kwayo yonke into, kwaye ndinqwenela ukukwamkela emphefumlweni wam. Ekubeni ndingenako ngoku ukukwamkela ngokwenyama, nceda uze emphefumlweni wam ngokomoya. Ndiyakwamkela ngathi sele ukhona, ndize ndizibophelele ngokupheleleyo kuwe. Ungaze undivumele ndahluke kuwe. Amen.
closing: Makusikelele uThixo uSomandla, uYise, noNyana, noMoya oyiNgcwele. Hamba ngoxolo.

readings.label: Isifundo sokuqala
readings.text: Mna, Yohane, ndeva iNkosi isithi kum: 'Kwingelosi yebandla laseSardesi, bhala oku: "Lowo unomoya osixhenxe kaThixo neenkwenkwezi ezisixhenxe uthi: Ndiyayazi imisebenzi yakho, ukuba unegama lokuba uphila, kodwa ufile. Phaphama, womeleze okushiyekileyo, okuzayo ukufa, kuba andifumananga misebenzi yakho iphelele phambi koThixo wam. Khumbula ke indlela owamkela noweva ngayo; yigcine, uguquke. Ukuba akwaphaphama, ndiya kuza njengesela, kwaye awusoze wazi ukuba ndiya kuza ngaliphi ilixa kuwe. Noko ke, unabantu abambalwa eSardesi abangazange bazingcolise iingubo zabo; baya kuhamba nam benxibe ezimhlophe, kuba befanelekile. Lowo woyisayo uya kunxityiswa ezimhlophe, kwaye andisoze ndilicime igama lakhe encwadini yobomi, ndiya kulivuma igama lakhe phambi koYise naphambi kweengelosi zakhe. Lowo unendlebe makave okuthethwa nguMoya emabandleni." Kwingelosi yebandla laseLawodikeya, bhala oku: "Amen, ungqina othembekileyo noyinyaniso, ingcambu yendalo kaThixo, uthi: Ndiyayazi imisebenzi yakho; ndiyazi ukuba awubandi, awushushu. Ndingathanda ukuba ububanda okanye ubushushu. Ngoko ke, ngenxa yokuba ufudumala, ungabandi ungashushu, ndiya kukuhlanza emlonyeni wam. Kuba uthi, "Ndi zityebi kwaye ndinobutyebi kwaye andisweli nto," kwaye awuqondi ukuba ulusizi, ulusizi, ulihlwempu, uyimfama, kwaye uhamba ze. Ndikucebisa ukuba uthenge kum igolide ecikicwe ngomlilo ukuze ube zityebi, neengubo ezimhlophe onokuzinxiba ukuze ukuhamba ze okuneentloni kungabhencwa, uthenge namaye okuthambisa amehlo akho ukuze ubone. Abo ndibathandayo, ndiyabohlwaya ndibaqeqeshe. Yiba nomdla ke, uguquke. Yabona, ndimi emnyango ndinkqonkqoza. Ukuba umntu weva ilizwi lam wavula umnyango, ndiya kungena endlwini yakhe ndidle naye, naye adle nam. Ndiya kunika owoyisayo ilungelo lokuhlala nam etroneni yam, njengokuba nam ndoyisileyo ndahlala noYise etroneni yakhe. Lowo unendlebe makave okuthethwa nguMoya emabandleni."

readings.label: Indumiso
readings.text: R. Ndiza kuhlala umoyisi ecaleni kwam etroneni yam. Ohamba engenakusoleka, enza ubulungisa; ocinga inyaniso entliziyweni yakhe, ongasahlekisi ngolwimi lwakhe. R. Ndiza kuhlala umoyisi ecaleni kwam etroneni yam. Ongenzakalisi mntu, ongathathi sikhumbuzo nxamnye nommelwane wakhe; ongayekiyo ukuyekwa ngabantu ababi, kodwa obeka abo boyika iNkosi. R. Ndiza kuhlala umoyisi ecaleni kwam etroneni yam. Ongaboleki mali yakhe ngenzala, ongamkeliyo irhwaphilizo nxamnye nomntu ongenatyala. Lowo wenza ezi zinto akayi kuze azanyazanyiswe. R. Ndiza kuhlala umoyisi ecaleni kwam etroneni yam.

readings.label: IVangeli
readings.text: Ngelo xesha uYesu weza eJeriko kwaye wayecebe ukudlula edolophini. Ngoku indoda apho egama linguZakeyu, owayengumphathi wabaqokeleli berhafu kwaye engumntu osisityebi, wayefuna ukubona ukuba ungubani na uYesu; kodwa wayengakwazi ukumbona ngenxa yesihlwele, kuba wayemfutshane. Ngoko ke wabaleka waya phambili wenyuka umthi womkhiwane ukuze abone uYesu, owayeza kudlula ngaloo ndlela. Xa wafikayo kuloo ndawo, uYesu wajonga phezulu wathi, 'Zakeyu, hla ngokukhawuleza, kuba namhlanje ndimelwe kukuhlala endlwini yakho.' Waza wehla ngokukhawuleza wamkela ngovuyo. Xa babona oku, baqalisa ukukhalaza, besithi, 'Uye kuhlala endlwini yomoni.' Kodwa uZakeyu wema apho wathi eNkosini, 'Bheka, isiqingatha seempahla zam, Nkosi, ndiya kunika amahlwempu, kwaye ukuba ndirhwaphilize nto kumntu, ndiya kubuyisela kane.' UYesu wathi kuye, 'Namhlanje usindiso lufikile kule ndlu kuba le ndoda nayo iyinzala kaAbraham. Kuba uNyana woMntu weza kufuna nokusindisa oko kwakulahlekile.'

pet_prayers.name: Dad
pet_prayers.text: Hey Ben - mom and I have been missing you a lot.   Saw you a few times in my dreams last few weeks! Come and say hi daily okay?
Thinking of you buddy! Stop by to say hello whenever you can okay? Love you Ben

pet_prayers.name: Dad
pet_prayers.text: Hey Ben - Been dreaming about you a lot. Hope you're having fun up in heaven. Please look after our family. Remember to come say hi daily. We miss you so much!

Ben ơi, trong giấc ngủ anh Huy đã thấy Ben về thăm anh, trao cho anh lời cầu nguyện để hai anh em mình lại được tìm thấy nhau. Xin Chúa thương nhậm lời Ben, cho Ben được hưởng ngàn thu bình an bên Chúa. Nếu có thể, xin Ben lại ghé thăm anh trong những giấc mơ tiếp theo nhé, dù chỉ là một lời chào hay một nụ cười thân thương như ngày nào.

pet_prayers.name: Dad
pet_prayers.text: Ben, my sweet boy, I miss you so much. Thank you for visiting me and Chú Chris last night. He told me he saw you flying a helicopter—so free, joyful, and strong up there. Down here, Mom and I are crying more and more each day. A piece of my heart feels completely dead without you, Ben. Please watch over us, pray for your mom, your brother Ryan, and me, and give us the strength to keep going. We love you forever
